//: Copy to scripts/arch.config.local.json (gitignored) for MACHINE-SPECIFIC settings only. It is shallow-merged over the committed scripts/arch.config.json, which holds the shared consumer list. You usually need none of this: the script finds a sibling codewatch checkout on its own.
//codewatchCli: Absolute path to a built @codewatch/cli entry (packages/cli/dist/index.js in a codewatch checkout). Only needed when your checkout is not a sibling of titan-design. @codewatch/cli is unpublished (AW-118), so npx cannot supply it. CODEWATCH_CLI in the environment wins over this.
//consumers: Overriding this REPLACES the shared list rather than adding to it, so a consumer you drop is silently scored as zero usage and its components land on the `dead` list. Add new consumers to the committed arch.config.json instead; override here only to repoint an existing entry at a checkout in an unusual place. kind 'native' scans react-native primitive imports; 'web' consumers use RNW/HTML.
